name: com.nexoider.coreaiunity
description: Unity framework for LLM-powered NPCs and agents that call your game code — drop-in chat UI, function-calling tools, persistent memory, token-by-token streaming, and per-role LLM routing. Runs on a local GGUF model (via LLMUnity) or any OpenAI-compatible API; proven on a 4 GB local model. Unity layer for com.nexoider.coreai.
